The NDJSON files in `snapshot/` are a few rows per table copied unchanged from `data/snapshot/` (snapshot 2026-10-10.1) for tests. They are third-party derived data under the same terms as `data/snapshot/`; see [data/README.md](../../../data/README.md). `snapshot/MANIFEST.json` is a test fixture (version `fixture-1`), not an export record. `content/` holds test-only text that makes no claim about the data.
